definition: CeVIO is the collective name of a range of computer software projects, including CeVIO Vision (digital signage), CeVIO Creative Studio (concatenative sampling–based vocal synthesis), and CeVIO AI (machine learning–based vocal synthesis).
details: CeVIO was made to assist in the creation of user-generated content. It works via a text-to-speech method.

explainer.lead: CeVIO is an umbrella name for software projects that help people create their own content, including synthetic voices and digital signage. Its two vocal-synthesis projects turn text into audio using different techniques: sampled sounds joined together in CeVIO Creative Studio, and machine learning in CeVIO AI.

tiers.eli5: CeVIO is like a creative toolbox whose tools can make computer-generated voices or digital signs. For a voice, you give it words and it turns them into audio. One tool builds the voice from sound samples, while another uses patterns learned by a computer.
tiers.practitioner: Treat CeVIO as a family of projects rather than a single synthesis engine. Use CeVIO Creative Studio when working with concatenative sampling-based vocal synthesis, CeVIO AI for machine-learning-based synthesis, and CeVIO Vision for digital signage. The main pitfall is attributing one project's synthesis method to the entire family.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, CeVIO = {CeVIO Vision, CeVIO Creative Studio, CeVIO AI}, with the vocal projects implementing a text-to-speech mapping f(text) -> synthetic vocal audio. Creative Studio uses concatenative sampling-based synthesis, whereas CeVIO AI uses machine-learning-based synthesis. Consequently, CeVIO names a collection of systems, not one common algorithm or model.

explainer.example: A creator enters “Good morning, everyone!” into CeVIO AI, generates the line with its machine-learning-based vocal synthesizer, and uses the resulting audio in a user-created work.

usedIn.name: CeVIO Creative Studio
usedIn.detail: Creates synthetic vocals through concatenative sampling-based synthesis.

usedIn.name: CeVIO AI
usedIn.detail: Creates synthetic vocals using machine-learning-based synthesis.

usedIn.name: CeVIO Vision
usedIn.detail: Supports digital-signage applications within the CeVIO project family.

explainer.intuition: CeVIO brings several content-creation tools under one name. For its vocal tools, the central idea is simple: written words go in, and a synthetic vocal rendering comes out, with the underlying technique depending on the project.
howItWorks: A creator chooses the CeVIO project suited to the task.
For vocal synthesis, the creator supplies text.
Creative Studio synthesizes audio using concatenative sampling, while CeVIO AI uses machine learning.
The resulting audio can support the creator's user-generated content.
CeVIO Vision separately addresses digital-signage use.
explainer.whyItMatters: CeVIO gives content creators access to synthetic vocal production and digital-signage software. Its distinct projects also illustrate two different routes to vocal synthesis: assembling sampled material and generating speech with machine learning.
misconceptions: CeVIO is not one single program; it is the collective name for several software projects.
Creative Studio and CeVIO AI do not use the same vocal-synthesis method.
The CeVIO family is not limited to vocal synthesis, because CeVIO Vision concerns digital signage.

diagram.caption: CeVIO spans digital signage and two vocal-synthesis projects that convert text into audio by different methods.
